headline: Two unsecured databases exposed 3.5 billion credentials as CISA confirmed exploitation of N-able MailAssure and AI agents took root in 11 minutes.

emerging_trends.text: AI agents now work both sides: Cairn operators took root in 11 minutes, while OpenAI and Cisco shipped Shirudo to buy patching time.
emerging_trends.topic_title: OpenAI and Cisco Ship Shirudo Shield

emerging_trends.text: Managed service provider plumbing keeps failing, with N-able MailAssure joining ConnectWise ScreenConnect and GL.iNet's cloud as paths into every downstream customer.
emerging_trends.topic_title: CISA Flags Exploited N-able MailAssure Flaw

emerging_trends.text: Energy operators keep absorbing intrusions, from Korea Electric Power Corporation and Equinor to Peninsula Energy, whose uranium mine incident stopped its share trading.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Peninsula Energy Halts Trading After Mine Hack

topics.title: CISA Flags Exploited N-able MailAssure Flaw
topics.latest_developments: CISA added N-able MailAssure flaw CVE-2026-134624, a server-side request forgery rated 9.3, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on Monday, citing active exploitation.
topics.why_it_matters: The bug sits in the email filtering cloud N-able runs for managed service providers, handing attackers a route to internal systems behind that service.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: N-able found the flaw while investigating the breach of its Mail Assure and SpamExperts Hosted Cloud. A user with high-level API access could open connections to chosen internal systems.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Apply the N-able patch and audit high-level API accounts. The company restored access to the affected services and continues to monitor those environments.

sources.title: Hackers Exploit N-able MailAssure Flaw While AI Agents Exploit MONAI Label Zero-Day
N-able Discloses Critical Mail Assure Vulnerability Found During Breach Investigation
N-able Patches Critical Flaw Discovered After Mail Assure Cyberattack

topics.title: Norway Names Equinor in Azure Token Hunt
topics.latest_developments: Norway's National Security Authority said an unknown actor hunted access tokens, secrets, and named values in Azure API Management, hitting energy firms Equinor and Skagerak Energi.
topics.why_it_matters: Stolen gateway credentials reach the backend systems an API fronts, turning one cloud flaw into access across Norwegian energy operations and other sectors.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Microsoft closed the flaw in Azure API Management Classic tiers. Rotate every secret, named value, and subscription key stored in the service.

details.label: Yes, but
details.text: The National Security Authority says it remains uncertain how the actor exploited the vulnerability.

sources.title: Microsoft Fixes Azure API Management Classic Flaw as Actor Targets Customer Secrets
Microsoft Azure flaw exploited to steal customers' API credentials
Azure Flaw Exploited to Target Secrets at Norwegian Energy Firms

topics.title: Cairn Agents Reach Root in 11 Minutes
topics.latest_developments: Dark Reading reported that a China-nexus actor's Cairn agents moved from finding the MONAI Label zero-day to root access in 11 minutes at East Asian universities.
topics.why_it_matters: Agentic tooling collapses the gap between flaw discovery and full compromise to minutes, far inside most patch and detection cycles.

details.label: What to do
details.text: CISA added the MONAI Label flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog Monday. Patch the medical imaging platform and block unauthenticated file writes outside its storage folder.

sources.title: AI Agents Zip From Flaw Discovery to Root Access in 11 Minutes
Hackers Exploit N-able MailAssure Flaw While AI Agents Exploit MONAI Label Zero-Day

topics.title: OpenAI and Cisco Ship Shirudo Shield
topics.latest_developments: OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, an open-source Linux runtime that lets AI agents write dynamic eBPF controls blocking exploit behavior with no restart.
topics.why_it_matters: Testing and deploying a Linux patch takes days or weeks, and the vulnerable service stays exposed the whole time.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Teams running exposed Linux services can deploy a shield that blocks the specific behavior a vulnerability depends on while they test the vendor fix.

sources.title: OpenAI and Cisco Unveil AI-Assisted Linux Security Tool to Block Exploits Before Patching
Linux patches can take weeks, and OpenAI and Cisco built Shirudo to help in the meantime

topics.title: Unsecured Databases Expose 3.5 Billion Records
topics.latest_developments: Wired reported that a pair of unsecured databases exposed 3.5 billion usernames, passwords, and documents tied to hundreds of millions of people.
topics.why_it_matters: A corpus that size fuels credential stuffing and account takeover, and the mix of logins and documents lets an attacker own a victim's digital life.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Force resets on reused corporate passwords and enforce multi-factor authentication. Watch customer login endpoints for credential stuffing spikes.

sources.title: Database Leaks Expose 3.5 Billion Usernames, Passwords, and Documents

topics.title: Ransomware Crews Set Record Victim Quarter
topics.latest_developments: Check Point Research counted 2,830 victims on ransomware leak sites in the third quarter of 2026, the highest quarterly total it has recorded.
topics.why_it_matters: A wider pool of brands keeps listing victims even as fewer pay, so exposure now lands on reputation and regulators rather than ransom math.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: July brought 964 victims, August 1,042, and September 824.

sources.title: Ransomware gangs keep multiplying, even as fewer victims pay

topics.title: Peninsula Energy Halts Trading After Mine Hack
topics.latest_developments: Peninsula Energy told the Australian Securities Exchange that a cybersecurity incident at its Wyoming uranium project will temporarily affect operations, and halted trading in its shares.
topics.why_it_matters: A uranium producer pulling its stock off the market shows how fast an intrusion at a mine becomes a disclosed financial event.

details.label: The big picture
details.text: Energy operators on three continents reported intrusions this week, among them Korea Electric Power Corporation, Equinor, and Skagerak Energi.

sources.title: Peninsula Energy Halts Trading After Cyber Incident Hits US Uranium Mine

business_politics.title: Nasdaq Futures Fall as AI Doubts Return
business_politics.latest_developments: Nasdaq futures pointed to a 2% drop early Tuesday, November 24, with Nvidia and Anthropic sliding premarket, one day after Jensen Huang's reinstatement sparked a global rally.
business_politics.why_it_matters: A second reversal in two sessions shows investors still doubt the artificial-intelligence build-out that now drives United States equity and currency direction.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: Ebury said the dollar's fortunes now track the AI trade. The DXY index slipped after touching a 20-month high.

details.label: What to watch
details.text: Gold fell as traders positioned for key United States inflation data due later this week.

sources.title: Stock Market Today: Tech Stocks Set to Dive Again After Epic Rally
Nasdaq Futures Fall as Questions Linger Over AI Trade
Dollar's Fortunes Closely Linked to AI Trade
US tech stocks set to slip after blistering rally

business_politics.title: Congress Attacks Huang's Nvidia Reinstatement
business_politics.latest_developments: Members of Congress turned on Nvidia's board for restoring Jensen Huang at President Trump's urging, and the Wall Street Journal detailed Secretary of State Marco Rubio's earlier warnings about the chipmaker.
business_politics.why_it_matters: White House involvement in picking a chief executive sets a precedent for every public company and every index investor holding Nvidia.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: The Wall Street Journal asked whether Nvidia now operates as a government-sponsored enterprise, steered from Washington as much as from its boardroom.

details.label: What to watch
details.text: Corporate governance specialists are weighing what the reinstatement does to board independence after a founder's removal.

sources.title: Rubio sounded alarms on Nvidia, but Trump and Huang persisted
Is Nvidia Becoming a Government-Sponsored Enterprise?
After Jensen Huang's Return, Where Does Corporate Governance Go?

business_politics.title: China Extends Critical Mineral Export Pause
business_politics.latest_developments: China extended its pause on export curbs for some critical materials to the United States until January, days after the Shenzhen summit between President Trump and Xi Jinping.
business_politics.why_it_matters: Magnet, chip, and defense manufacturers get a six-week reprieve while Beijing keeps a supply-chain lever it can pull again in January.

details.label: The big picture
details.text: Beijing's grip on critical mineral processing remains its strongest point of leverage over Washington, the Financial Times reported.

sources.title: China to Suspend Some Critical-Material Export Curbs to U.S. Until January
China extends pause in controls on critical mineral exports to US

business_politics.title: Pentagon Delays Patriot Interceptors for Ukraine
business_politics.latest_developments: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has not signed off on 60 Patriot interceptors bound for Ukraine, including missiles held in European arsenals, the Financial Times reported Tuesday, November 24.
business_politics.why_it_matters: Kyiv's air defenses thin out as Russia keeps striking infrastructure, and European governments wait on Washington to release stock they already bought.

details.label: What to watch
details.text: Ukrainian sea drones keep hitting Russian warships and freighters across the Black Sea, Baltic, and Mediterranean, the Financial Times reported.

sources.title: Pentagon delays Patriot missile shipments to Ukraine
Russian navy licks its wounds as another warship is sunk

business.title: Allegheny County Pension Gap Persists Into 2027
business.latest_developments: A TribLive editorial Tuesday, November 24, said Allegheny County workers get no pension contribution relief in 2027 and called for a structural fix to the county's pension fund.
business.why_it_matters: County employees keep absorbing the cost through their paychecks while the fund's longer-running funding problem stays on the books for taxpayers.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: The editorial frames the county's 2027 approach as another patch on the fund rather than a repair of its finances.

sources.title: Editorial: Allegheny County needs to fix pension fund, not just patch it

business.title: Estrogen Patch Shortage Hits Local Patients
business.latest_developments: Women in the Pittsburgh region cannot fill prescribed estrogen patches, and lawmakers are pressing the Food and Drug Administration to formally recognize a shortage, WPXI reported Tuesday, November 24.
business.why_it_matters: Patients treating menopause and perimenopause symptoms have no guaranteed path to refills until federal regulators list the drug as short.

sources.title: Women struggling to find estrogen patches as lawmakers push FDA to recognize shortage

around_town.title: Democratic Majority Could Lift College Funding
around_town.latest_developments: PublicSource reported Tuesday, November 24, that Pennsylvania's incoming Democratic legislative majority could raise appropriations for state-related universities, the state system, and community colleges.
around_town.why_it_matters: Higher state support would ease budget pressure at the University of Pittsburgh and other Pittsburgh-area public colleges, and at the students paying tuition.

details.label: What they're saying
details.text: State Sen. Jay Costa said there is "a greater receptiveness to wanting to increase the funding," then cautioned that lawmakers face "a lot of requests."

sources.title: 'Blue Wave' could bring Pittsburgh colleges more money

around_town.title: Unity Fire Departments Merge Operations
around_town.latest_developments: The Dryridge and Marguerite volunteer fire departments combined operations in Unity Township, completing a long-planned consolidation, TribLive reported Tuesday, November 24.
around_town.why_it_matters: Unity Township now runs volunteer fire coverage on one roster and one budget as recruiting volunteers gets harder.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: Township officials call the merger a proactive move to keep volunteer fire protection sustainable in Unity.

sources.title: Unity volunteer fire departments merge as Dryridge, Marguerite combine operations

around_town.title: Pittsburgh Families Fear Losing School Sports
around_town.latest_developments: Parents and student athletes told WTAE Monday, November 23, that the school closures Pittsburgh Public Schools is planning could gut their teams over the next few years.
around_town.why_it_matters: Rosters and coaching staffs depend on which buildings close, leaving student athletes unsure where they will play next season.

details.label: Flashback
details.text: Families pressed the district days earlier to negotiate a new cooperative before dissolving USO, the shared sports program for University Prep, Science & Technology Academy, and Obama Academy.

sources.title: Pittsburgh Public Schools families fear losing sports teams amid school closures

events.title: Leslie Odom Jr. Brings Christmas Tour Home
events.latest_developments: Leslie Odom Jr., the Carnegie Mellon University graduate and original "Hamilton" cast member, brings his Christmas Tour to Heinz Hall, he told NEXTpittsburgh Tuesday, November 24.
events.why_it_matters: Pittsburgh's holiday calendar gains a marquee concert from a Broadway star who trained in the city.

details.label: When
details.text: Tuesday, December 8, 2026.

details.label: Where
details.text: Heinz Hall in downtown Pittsburgh.

sources.title: Ahead of his Heinz Hall holiday show, CMU grad Leslie Odom Jr. talks Pittsburgh, 'Hamilton' and fries on his salad

around_teams.title: Steelers Host Broncos Friday on Prime Video
around_teams.latest_developments: The Steelers host the Denver Broncos Friday, November 27, at 3 p.m. ET on Prime Video, the team's channel said, as head coach Mike McCarthy briefed reporters on the matchup.
around_teams.why_it_matters: A Thanksgiving-weekend afternoon kickoff on a streaming service changes how Pittsburgh fans watch a game that shapes the AFC North race.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Matt Williamson and Wes Uhler turned Monday's SNR Drive to Denver after reviewing the Week 11 trip to Philadelphia, with Steelers broadcaster Rob King calling in.

team_usa.title: Pochettino May Tap USMNT Players at United
team_usa.latest_developments: ESPN examined Tuesday, November 24, which United States men's national team players Mauricio Pochettino could sign at Manchester United, where a 4-0 loss to Liverpool opened his tenure.
team_usa.why_it_matters: Moves to Old Trafford would push American internationals into a Premier League relegation fight midway through the World Cup cycle.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: ESPN reported Manchester United must spend about 150 million pounds in January or risk losing 300 million pounds to relegation.

sources.title: Which USMNT players could follow Pochettino to Manchester United?
Man United will need big January transfer spending to avoid relegation
